```{r setup, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  cache = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center"
)

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
```

```{r table-type-I-error}
df <- readRDS("data/pvalues_type_I_error.rds")

kable(
  x = df, 
  col.names = c("Method", sub("^p", "", colnames(df)[-1L])),
  format = "latex",
  digits = 4L
) %>%
  add_header_above(
    header = c(" " = 2L, "Nominal P-value" = 4L)
  )
```
